persona.name: Nikola Petrovic
persona.bio: Nikola Petrovic documents historic churches and cultural landmarks, splitting time between archive work and photo expeditions. He plans travel carefully, coordinates with curators abroad, and loves sharing the stories behind architecture with friends back home.
persona.writing_style: Thoughtful and polite, proper capitalization, complete sentences
sample_messages: Do you know if the monastery in Ravenna allows interior photography?

   - Approximate service date (you said last week—do you know the exact date?)

Also, did you have more than one plumbing service done last week, or just this one?
</action>
